task: Audit the widened checker/emitter expression-reader lint and its indirect reader coverage.
observation: The linter's emitter path inventory omits src/executor_invoke_codegen.inc, where gen_executor_statement still calls parse_executor_chain(s.b, calls). The existing --require-zero emitter command reports zero; adding this include to the emitter inventory detects one active string reader.
impact: The current gate gives a false green for the requested emitter-reader invariant, so a migration regression can bypass the checker without changing the counted files.

resolution.summary: Review evidence records the missing emitter include and verifies the false-zero; the gate source was intentionally left untouched in this report-only audit.

reproducer: Attribute src/executor_invoke_codegen.inc to emitter in CONSUMER_PATHS; sites() then finds parse_executor_chain at line 138, while the unmodified --require-zero emitter run passes.
suggestion: Include executor_invoke_codegen.inc in the emitter reader inventory and keep its parse_executor_chain call subject to the zero-reader gate.
